options.name: echo_interface
options.description: Loopback interface used for echo frames. Valid values are loopback interface name or 'deleted'. Not supported on N5K/N6K

options.name: echo_rx_interval
options.description: BFD Echo receive interval in milliseconds.

options.name: fabricpath_interval
options.description: BFD fabricpath interval timer values. Value must be a dict defining values for keys (tx, min_rx, and multiplier).

options.name: fabricpath_slow_timer
options.description: BFD fabricpath slow rate timer in milliseconds.

options.name: interval
options.description: BFD interval timer values. Value must be a dict defining values for keys (tx, min_rx, and multiplier)

options.name: ipv4_echo_rx_interval
options.description: BFD IPv4 session echo receive interval in milliseconds.

options.name: ipv4_interval
options.description: BFD IPv4 interval timer values. Value must be a dict defining values for keys (tx, min_rx, and multiplier).

options.name: ipv4_slow_timer
options.description: BFD IPv4 slow rate timer in milliseconds.

options.name: ipv6_echo_rx_interval
options.description: BFD IPv6 session echo receive interval in milliseconds.

options.name: ipv6_interval
options.description: BFD IPv6 interval timer values. Value must be a dict defining values for keys (tx, min_rx, and multiplier).

options.name: ipv6_slow_timer
options.description: BFD IPv6 slow rate timer in milliseconds.

options.name: slow_timer
options.description: BFD slow rate timer in milliseconds.

options.name: startup_timer
options.description: BFD delayed startup timer in seconds. Not supported on N5K/N6K/N7K
